Skills

DevOps Technologies

Advanced

Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure, IaC & Configuration Management: Terraform, Containers & Orchestration: Docker and Kubernetes (AKS preferred), Version Control: Git and Azure Repos and GitHub, Scripting & Automation: PowerShell and Bash and YAML, Monitoring & Logging: Azure Monitor and Nagios and Grafana and Prometheus, Cluster Management: Kubernetes, CI/CD Tools: Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions

Certifications

AWS Cloud Practitioner Certified

Amazon Web Services

Python

Udemy

TeMIP Admin

HPE

Languages

English, Hindi , Punjabi

Summary

Experienced IT Professional with 12.8+ years in the industry, including 5+ years

as a DevOps Engineer. Over 6 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft

Azure Cloud, delivering robust, scalable, and secure solutions. Proven expertise

in automating infrastructure, orchestrating CI/CD pipelines, and implementing

cloud-native architectures. Skilled in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using

Terraform, containerization with Docker, and pipeline automation using Azure

DevOps and GitHub Actions. Adept at enhancing system reliability, accelerating

deployment cycles, and driving operational efficiency through automation and

industry best practices.

Experience

Wipro Limited

May 2022 to Present

Management Consultant

Gurgaon , Haryana

Leading DevOps and cloud automation initiatives in Telecom OSS and

infrastructure management.

Developed and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub

Actions to streamline and accelerate deployment workflows.

Created standardized YAML-based CI/CD pipeline templates in Azure

DevOps, accelerating deployment onboarding for new projects.

Designed and implemented automated infrastructure using Terraform for

deploying Azure resources (VMs, VNets, App Services, etc.).

Implemented modular IaC using Terraform, improving infrastructure

reusability and maintainability.

Managing Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters for high-availability

telecom applications.

Monitoring & Logging: Deployed and managed Prometheus, Grafana, and

Nagios for observability and monitoring.

Worked extensively with Docker and Kubernetes (K8s) to deploy

microservices-based applications.

Scripting & Automation: Developed automation scripts using Python, Shell

Scripting, and PowerShell to improve operational efficiency.

Strong leadership experience in technical project execution, stakeholder

communication, and team mentoring.

Hewlett-Packard Enterprise

April 2019 to April 2022

DevOps and Cloud Engineer

Gurgaon , Haryana

Migrated on-premise workloads to Azure using Azure Migrate and

Terraform, streamlining infrastructure management and helping reduce

operational overhead.

Regularly worked with Docker — building images, writing Dockerfiles,

managing registries, and using Docker Hub for multi-container setups.

Worked on Azure networking — including virtual networks, VPN gateways,

ExpressRoute, DNS, and load balancers — to ensure secure and scalable

cloud connectivity with on-prem environments

Configured Network Security Groups (NSGs) at the subnet and NIC level to

enforce tight access controls across Azure virtual machines.

Integrated static code analysis and testing stages into CI/CD pipelines using

Azure DevOps.

Automated resource provisioning using Terraform, enabling consistent and

repeatable deployments across multiple environments.

Focused on infrastructure as code practices using Terraform — writing

plans, managing changes, and automating cloud infrastructure rollout on

Azure.

Configured Azure Active Directory (AAD), role-based access control (RBAC),

and policies for secure and compliant access to cloud resources.

Hewlett-Packard Enterprise, Gurgaon (Third Party)

April 2015 to March 2019

Senior Application Support & System Engineer

Gurgaon , Haryana

Worked as Shift Lead, managing operations and ensuring seamless

application support.

Regular health checkup and Performance Monitoring of servers.

Applied OS hardening best practices, including disabling unused services,

enforcing strong password policies, and enabling automatic security

updates.

Configured automatic patching and kernel updates to keep Linux servers

secure and compliant.

Collaborated with Primus Global Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (April 2018 – March

2019) and Vega Innovations and Technology Pvt. Ltd. (August 2015 – March

2018) on the same project

IKYA Human Capital Solutions Pvt Ltd(New Delhi), Client

Sept 2012 to Aug 2015

Side ( INDUS TOWERS)

Gurgaon , Haryana

Sr. Executive-NOC (O&M)]

Provided national-level NOC network support, ensuring smooth telecom

operations and minimal downtime.

Managed alarm analysis, fault management, and RCA automation to

improve network stability.

Led OSS/EMS integration with vendors (NSN, Ericsson, ZTE, Huawei) for

enhanced system performance.

Conducted UAT and administration of NOC applications, including TeMIP,

Helix NetKT, and I-Navigator.

Generated and analyzed KPI reports, outage reports, and performance

analysis reports to optimize operations.

Provided support for Indus NOC Project for Indus Towers India.

World Institute of Technology(MDU

B.Tech (Electronics & Communication) 2012

Rohtak)

Sohna( Gurgaon)
